largeFileFlows.scope: Complete nested Parse file -> JSON Lines -> Render file flows; every value and rendered byte audited
largeFileFlows.limitations: Synthetic local files. Timings cover flow execution, excluding archive creation/startup/cleanup and output audits. 10 ms sampled RSS can miss short peaks; no constant-RSS guarantee or long-duration soak claim.

verification.studioBuild: Passed npm run build: documentation fingerprints, renderer licenses, TypeScript and Vite

frontendTests.scope: Includes pure Studio contract checks for stream paths, nested path types, metadata output and legacy mode

capabilities: Nested object/array paths and JSON-valued repeating columns
Schema-derived nested columns and optional batch XSD validation
Bounded Parse file -> JSON Lines and Render JSON Lines -> formatted file
Bounded malformed-quote recovery with replay and physical-line policy
Atomic output replacement and cooperative cancellation
limitations: Nested hierarchy is inside a logical record; header/detail/trailer relationships require explicit business grouping
Malformed unclosed quotes are ambiguous; review recovered records/rejects and use physical-line policy for single-line contracts
Stream XSD validation is per batch, not global document keys/cardinality
Reject and main output are independently published, not a multi-file transaction
String/legacy record modes remain available and materialize their requested result
Large-file tests use 10 ms sampled RSS, not a constant-memory guarantee or long-duration soak
